tool.name: team-task-update
tool.description:
Drives the team task state machine (claim / complete / abandon) on the caller's team's shared task store.
**Parameters**: - `taskId`: the task identity returned by team-task-create (required). - `action`: one of `claim` / `complete` / `abandon` (required, case-insensitive). `complete` applies only to a CLAIMED task; `abandon` on an unclaimed (CREATED) task is an ADMIN-only operation (MEMBER is denied).
**Semantics**: - The task must belong to the caller's team (cross-team taskId is rejected). - ACL: `claim`/`complete`/`abandon-claimed` require EXECUTE; `abandon-unclaimed` requires ADMIN (LEAD only). - Honest fail-loud: if team functionality or the task store is not enabled (NoOp defaults) the tool reports the operation was NOT performed. An illegal state transition returns an explicit "not applied + current status" result — never a silent success.
